name: Hiver
description: Six-limbed beings resembling a fleshy dome about one metre across, with manipulator tentacles at the end of each limb. Hivers have no vocal chords and communicate through sign language, typically via a Voder device. Masters of indirect manipulation, they have built a vast interstellar federation through persuasion rather than force. A Hiver's social standing is known as Resolve (RES) rather than Social Standing (SOC). Hivers have no psionic potential whatsoever.

traits.name: Manipulative
traits.description: Hivers receive DM+1 on all Deception and Persuade checks when working indirectly — setting up a situation, planting an idea, or guiding someone to a conclusion they believe they reached themselves. They suffer DM-2 on checks requiring direct assertion of authority.

traits.name: Non-Vocal
traits.description: Hivers have no vocal chords. They communicate through sign language, typically using a Voder device that translates their movements into speech or text. Without a Voder, communication with non-Hiver speakers requires a Difficult (10+) Diplomat check to convey anything specific. All Hivers are fluent in Hiver sign language and Gurvin.

traits.name: Six Limbs
traits.description: All six Hiver limbs can function as both arms and legs. One limb serves as a 'head' with eye-stalks. Hivers can manipulate objects with multiple limbs simultaneously, gaining DM+1 on tasks requiring fine manipulation with two or more objects at once.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.description: Hivers can regenerate most minor injuries over time. However, major trauma (loss of a limb in a manner that cannot be regrown, severe scarring) requires medical intervention and may leave permanent effects.

traits.name: Violence Aversion
traits.description: Hivers have a deep instinctive aversion to violence and direct confrontation. A Hiver who must engage in personal combat suffers DM-2 on all attack rolls. Hivers cannot normally gain or use military combat skills above level 1 unless they are in a Manipulator (Military Leader) assignment.

source: Aliens of Charted Space Vol. 2, Mongoose Publishing
notes: SOC characteristic represents Resolve (RES) — a Hiver's social influence and willpower. Advancement in all Hiver careers is via a 2D + RES DM check against Average (8+); the numeric result is then checked against the advancement status table (≤9=Adult, 10-14=Senior, 15=Manipulator). Hivers do not make survival checks in Federation careers. No basic training is ever received (neither in the first term nor when switching careers). Mustering out: 2 rolls per term + RES DM; at least half (round down) must be cash rolls. The mustering out table is 2D-based (not 1D). Anagathics do not work on Hivers. Hivers have no psionic ability of any kind.
